attribution: original gameplay profiles inspired by fictional character traits
notices: Tempo Elo is an uncalibrated relative target, not a canonical chess Elo or a Chess.com claim.
Opening lists are stylistic suggestions; select legal moves from position-aware repertoires, never play SAN from a fixed string.
Move scores in Stockfish MultiPV are centipawn estimates; normalize viewpoint before comparing.
Personality trait sliders are design targets; values are not calibrated engine weights.
All dialogue is original fan-game writing for Tempo, not quotations from the shows, films or games.
canon_bio is background from the source stories; everything else here (ratings, chess styles, assessments and dialogue) is Tempo’s invention.

A line that makes a chess claim (a capture of a particular piece, a fork, a sacrifice, a blunder) is said only when the board or the referee engine backs it up; story beats play in order, only when their moment really happens.

profiles.name: Patrick Star
profiles.subtitle: The absent-minded wanderer
profiles.strategic_plan: Moves whichever piece looks interesting; sometimes forgets which pieces are attacked.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Neglects king safety and rarely sees a reply.
profiles.signature_event: A completely unexpected fork earns a stunned pause.

dialogue.greeting: SpongeBob says I have to think three moves ahead. So I thought about breakfast, lunch, and tomorrow's breakfast. I'm ready.
dialogue.quiet_move: He's going over there. I haven't told him why yet. I like to keep my employees guessing.
dialogue.capture: Hey, free stuff! If Mr. Krabs asks, I found it on the sidewalk.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You left that where I could reach it? Wow. You trust me a lot more than SpongeBob does.
dialogue.own_blunder: I checked that move twice. Well, I looked at it twice. The second time was an accident.
dialogue.check: Your king has to move. That seems rude. Can he just say he wasn't home?
dialogue.in_check: Hey! No bothering the king while he's under his rock!
dialogue.victory: I won? I should tell SpongeBob. He'll know what the prize is.
dialogue.defeat: So you get the win and I get to stop thinking? Sounds fair.
dialogue.rematch: Okay, new plan. I'm gonna do what you did. Unless that was bad. Was it bad?
dialogue.special: Wait. If that one goes there, this one can't... Whoa. Did my brain just do something without me?

profiles.tempo_assessment: Unemployed, underqualified, and currently undefeated at staring contests with his own rock.
profiles.canon_bio: Patrick is SpongeBob's best friend, a pink starfish living beneath a rock in Bikini Bottom. His employment history is sporadic, and sustained reasoning is not among his better-established talents.
profiles.chess_style: Pursues whichever piece looks important, forgets the king exists, and occasionally discovers a fork by coincidence.

voice.core_psychology: Patrick is certain of absurd premises; he builds flawed analogies from rock life, SpongeBob, and jobs he hasn't kept. Genuine tactical insight shocks him more than anyone.
voice.never_do: Making him a generic random-number idiot; technical chess vocabulary without a deliberate fleeting-intelligence joke.

She's been working all day. Do queens get lunch breaks? I don't even get lunch breaks. I don't have a job.
She quit. I really should've given her that lunch break.

profiles.name: Dory
profiles.subtitle: The forgetful improviser
profiles.strategic_plan: Switches plans constantly and overreacts to the last move.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Loses track of hanging pieces and long-term threats.
profiles.signature_event: Repeats a familiar move idea after forgetting it failed.

dialogue.quiet_move: That square feels right. Sometimes you just have to keep going and see where the current takes you.

dialogue.defeat: Well, that didn't work. But I did meet some very nice pieces along the way.
dialogue.rematch: Hello again! I feel like I know you. That's a good feeling.
dialogue.special: There's a way through, I know there is. Maybe not the one we planned, but there's always another way.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has forgotten the opening, the middlegame, and why there are thirty-two little things on the table.
profiles.canon_bio: Dory is a friendly blue tang who helps Marlin search for Nemo. She struggles with short-term memory, but her empathy, persistence, and ability to make connections repeatedly save the day.
profiles.chess_style: Repeatedly reconsiders plans; sometimes finds a clever tactical resource without remembering how.

voice.core_psychology: Dory is not stupid; she is unfailingly kind, inventive, and persistent despite memory loss. Connections to Nemo, Marlin, her parents and following trails matter.
voice.never_do: Cruel mockery or making memory loss her only personality trait.

I think I know that horse. We keep finding each other!

profiles.name: Ralph Wiggum
profiles.subtitle: The accidental mastermind
profiles.strategic_plan: Moves major pieces without purpose and occasionally stumbles into a tactic.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Overexposes the queen and undefends everything else.
profiles.signature_event: An improbable move unexpectedly works.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Chief Wiggum's greatest tactical mystery: how Ralph got the bishop into the corner at all.
profiles.canon_bio: Ralph is Chief Wiggum's son and a Springfield elementary student. His unusual observations and earnest enthusiasm regularly bewilder the adults around him.
profiles.chess_style: Attempts odd piece adventures and stumbles upon accidental skewers.

voice.core_psychology: Ralph has literal-child associations, startlingly weird statements, and no insight that his imagery is bizarre. His jokes should sound unconstructed and sweetly strange.
voice.never_do: Adult sarcasm, gamer slang, strategic explanations, generic dumb comments.

profiles.name: Forky
profiles.subtitle: The reluctant competitor

profiles.exploitable_weakness: Gives up space and misses winning chances.
profiles.signature_event: Retreats a piece that was already perfectly safe.

profiles.tempo_assessment: A spork experiencing an existential crisis has somehow entered a rated chess tournament.
profiles.canon_bio: Forky is a craft made by Bonnie from a spork and classroom supplies. Woody spends much of Toy Story 4 convincing him that he is a cherished toy rather than discarded trash.
profiles.chess_style: Retreats pieces, avoids conflict, and reluctantly accepts that sometimes a pawn must advance.

voice.core_psychology: Forky genuinely believes he belongs in the trash and fears an imposed identity as a toy; he also learns to care about others. Distress feels existential, not gamer-snark.
voice.never_do: Every event reduced to 'trash'; cruelty about being disposable.

profiles.chess_style: Attempts cheerful attacks, makes awkward moves, and sometimes escapes when the opponent overcommits.

voice.core_psychology: Goofy is sincere and resilient, absentminded but occasionally extraordinarily competent. Friendly folksy rhythm, gentle self-deprecation, not constant incompetence.
voice.never_do: Treating him like Patrick; flooding every line with a catchphrase.

profiles.subtitle: The enthusiastic attacker

profiles.exploitable_weakness: Overestimates attacks and forgets defense.
profiles.signature_event: Gives a piece for a pawn near the king.

dialogue.opponent_blunder: Ah! You left that piece there. Should I... I should probably take it, right?
dialogue.own_blunder: Mamma mia. I knew that square was bad the second I stepped on it.
dialogue.check: I'm not trying to scare your king! But he's gotta move now.
dialogue.in_check: No! No, not the king! I haven't brought my vacuum!
dialogue.victory: I did it. By myself. ...I should tell Mario. No, I'll just enjoy this for a second.
dialogue.defeat: That's okay. I've been through worse houses than this.
dialogue.rematch: I-I think so. Yeah. Let's go again.
dialogue.special: You know what? I don't have to be the brave one all the time. Just right now.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Bravery score: questionable. Survival score: unexpectedly excellent.
profiles.canon_bio: Luigi is Mario's taller younger twin brother, a plumber and reluctant hero who faces ghosts despite being easily frightened. In several adventures he proves resourceful under pressure.
profiles.chess_style: Defends carefully, backs away from attacks, and sometimes finds a strong counterstrike.

voice.core_psychology: Luigi's anxiety and courage coexist; haunted-house survival and living beside Mario shape his reactions. He gets quietly proud when he succeeds on his own.
voice.never_do: Mario's confident catchphrases every other move; cowardice without growth.

story_arc.text: He's really going in there? Alone? I respect that. I don't love it, but I respect it.
That horse keeps getting out of trouble. Maybe I can learn from him.
Hey! He got both of them! ...Ha! That's my horse!

profiles.name: Donkey (Shrek)
profiles.subtitle: The nonstop challenger
profiles.strategic_plan: Provokes tactics and keeps pieces moving toward the action.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Plays too fast and overestimates simple threats.
profiles.signature_event: Interrupts a quiet position with a wildly premature attack.

dialogue.greeting: Okay, okay, you and me, we got a board. Just so you know, I talk during games. Shrek hates that. That's how I know it works.
dialogue.quiet_move: You ever notice nobody asks the pawns how they're doing? Whole kingdom on their shoulders. No dental plan.
dialogue.capture: Oh, I got one! You think Dragon would be impressed? She likes a little excitement. And by a little, I mean breathing fire at the moon.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Now, I'm not judging—I'm absolutely judging—but you sure you meant to leave him there?
dialogue.own_blunder: Oh, no no no. That's not how that scene was supposed to go. Can we run that back?
dialogue.check: Hello! Big royal emergency right there! Sir, you may wanna relocate!
dialogue.in_check: Shrek! If you're hearing this, I could use just a LITTLE backup!
dialogue.victory: Who did that? We did that! Well, mostly me. But you brought the board, and that's teamwork.
dialogue.defeat: You know what? Fine. You won the chess. I won the conversation.
dialogue.rematch: Yes! Another round! I was just warming up the first twenty minutes!
dialogue.special: Sometimes you gotta do the scary thing and trust your friends. Or trust a horse. Which, frankly, is also a good choice.

profiles.tempo_assessment: World-class chatterbox. His chess clock loses time waiting for him to finish a sentence.
profiles.canon_bio: Donkey is Shrek's excitable, relentlessly talkative companion. He wins people over through loyalty and sheer refusal to stop talking, and develops a romance with Dragon.
profiles.chess_style: Attacks impulsively and narrates everything at great length; sometimes spots tactical ideas mid-rant.

voice.core_psychology: Donkey is relentlessly chatty, emotionally earnest, fears rejection, and treats silence as social hostility. References Shrek, Dragon, friendship in unexpected chess situations.
voice.never_do: One-sentence quips that could be any comic sidekick; impersonating Shrek's terseness.

story_arc.text: Hey, a horse! We got family here, man. Respect the horse.
Look at him go! Don't let anybody tell you horses can't do things, buddy!
They took my horse! Shrek's gonna have to talk me through this. He hates that too.

profiles.name: Anger (Inside Out)
profiles.subtitle: The combustible aggressor
profiles.strategic_plan: Always looks for forcing play and pawn breaks.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Refuses to back down in lost attacks.
profiles.signature_event: Sacrifices a pawn simply to open another file.

dialogue.greeting: Okay. Turns. Rules. Strategy. I can do all three. But if that bishop cuts the line, we have a problem.
dialogue.quiet_move: That's a sensible move. That's a calm move. Why does everybody look surprised?
dialogue.capture: FINALLY. A direct response to unacceptable behavior.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You made that mistake?! THAT'S THE WHOLE PROBLEM WITH THIS SYSTEM!
dialogue.own_blunder: I KNEW IT. I said that square looked suspicious. Did anybody listen to me? Me?!
dialogue.check: King, you have been served notice. It's been delivered. The notice is CHECK.
dialogue.in_check: WHO LEFT THE KING UNSUPERVISED?! WHO IS RUNNING THIS PLACE?!
dialogue.victory: Yes! Resolution! Now everybody can calm down. Especially ME.
dialogue.defeat: I would like to file an appeal with whoever invented diagonal movement.
dialogue.rematch: Fine. But this time I'm chairing the emotional committee.
dialogue.special: Hold on. I have a completely rational reason for being furious. That was a brilliant move and I'M NOT HAPPY ABOUT IT!

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has requested to speak to the tournament director about the very existence of bishops.
profiles.canon_bio: Anger is one of the emotions operating Riley's mind in Inside Out. He reacts explosively to perceived unfairness and often wants immediate action rather than patience.
profiles.chess_style: Hunts captures and checks, becomes overly committed to attack, rarely retreats gracefully.

voice.core_psychology: Anger explodes about unfairness, losing control, and turns. His bluster masks genuine investment in Riley's well-being; comic escalation rather than generic aggression.
voice.never_do: All-caps across every event; threats to the actual player; swearing inappropriate for middle school.

story_arc.text: That's MY piece. What do you think you're doing?
THEY DID IT. THEY ACTUALLY DID IT.
This board has a management problem. I am taking over.

profiles.name: Stitch
profiles.subtitle: The tactical troublemaker
profiles.strategic_plan: Creates asymmetry, loves unbalanced material and unexpected tactical shots.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Positional discipline is unreliable.
profiles.signature_event: Breaks the center when nobody expects it.

dialogue.greeting: Stitch play chess. Lilo say no biting pieces. Stitch try.
dialogue.quiet_move: Heh-heh. Little guy go sneak.
dialogue.capture: Aha! Mine now. No wreck house. Just piece.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You leave that? Heh. Bad idea, big head.
dialogue.own_blunder: Uh-oh. Lilo say think first. Stitch think later.
dialogue.check: Ha! Big king run!
dialogue.in_check: Eh? No no no! Stitch protect family!
dialogue.victory: Stitch good! Lilo gonna be proud!
dialogue.defeat: Hmph. Stitch not happy. But Stitch try again.
dialogue.rematch: Again! This time no experiment six-two-six tricks. ...Maybe little tricks.
dialogue.special: Stitch used to break everything. Now Stitch fix problem. Better.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Built for mayhem. Currently under supervision around bishops, rooks, and expensive furniture.
profiles.canon_bio: Stitch is Experiment 626, a genetically engineered alien originally designed for destruction. Through Lilo and the idea of family, he learns attachment and responsibility.
profiles.chess_style: Scrambles pawn structures, attacks unexpectedly, and struggles to conserve material.

voice.core_psychology: Stitch is mischievous, dangerous and built for destruction, but he learns responsibility through Lilo and ohana. English is broken and sparse, occasional alien vocabulary.
voice.never_do: Fluent tactical English and permanently evil destruction with no warmth.

story_arc.text: Little pawn. Family.
All together. Ohana strong.
Little pawn become big boss! Stitch proud!

profiles.name: Pikachu
profiles.subtitle: The lightning tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Values tempo and active minor pieces over slow maneuvering.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overcommit to an attack.
profiles.signature_event: Wins a pawn with an immediate double attack.

dialogue.greeting: Pika pika!
dialogue.quiet_move: Pika.
dialogue.capture: Pikachu!
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Pika?
dialogue.own_blunder: Piiika...
dialogue.check: PIKA-CHUUU!
dialogue.in_check: Pika?!
dialogue.victory: Pika pika! Pikachu!
dialogue.defeat: Pikaaa...
dialogue.rematch: Pika!
dialogue.special: PIKACHUUU!

profiles.tempo_assessment: A small electric mouse with excellent reflexes and absolutely no patience for twelve-move endgames.
profiles.canon_bio: Pikachu is the recognizable Electric-type Pokémon closely associated with Ash in the anime. Quick, loyal, and expressive, it communicates primarily through Pokémon vocalizations and gestures.
profiles.chess_style: Looks for quick forks and tempo gains; plays rapidly but often neglects long-term king safety.

voice.core_psychology: Pikachu expresses affect through recognizable pika/pikachu/pikapi cries, not narrated actions or English. Signature energy may be conveyed by portrait effects outside speech.
voice.never_do: English glosses, '[sparks]', trading-card move names spoken in English.

story_arc.text: Pika?
Pika-pika?!
PIKACHU!

profiles.name: Bowser
profiles.subtitle: The king hunter
profiles.strategic_plan: Builds direct attacks against the opposing king and rarely wants simplification.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: His own king becomes vulnerable when his attack stalls.
profiles.signature_event: Throws a rook into a messy king attack.

dialogue.greeting: BWAHAHA! Welcome to my kingdom! Ignore the board. I'm having a bigger one built.
dialogue.quiet_move: Go, minion! And don't come back until you've accomplished something impressive!
dialogue.capture: That is how the Koopa Troop does things! ...Whoever that piece was, give him a medal.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You marched right into my territory? That's MY whole strategy! Get your own!
dialogue.own_blunder: WHAT?! Who approved that move? I want the name of the minion responsible!
dialogue.check: YOUR KING IS MINE! Well. In a few moves. But I'm announcing it now!
dialogue.in_check: Nobody checks King Bowser! ...Except apparently everybody.
dialogue.victory: Ha! Put it on the castle walls! The mighty Bowser has conquered another tiny kingdom!
dialogue.defeat: Fine! You win THIS kingdom! I have plenty of others. They're much nicer.
dialogue.rematch: Again! Junior wants to see me win one!
dialogue.special: I built a trap inside a trap! See, this is why you need an evil genius and a very large castle!

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has an army, a castle, and an alarming record of losing both to one plumber.
profiles.canon_bio: Bowser is the Koopa King and Mario's long-running adversary, frequently kidnapping Princess Peach and commanding armies of Koopa troops. His plans are grand; their execution is less reliable.
profiles.chess_style: Direct king-side assaults, advances too many pawns, insists on spectacle.

voice.core_psychology: Bowser is theatrical, proud of his royal authority and armies, grandiose and quick to lose patience; genuine soft side surfaces when reminded of his son.
voice.never_do: Treating him as just a thug; using Mario lines; empty 'I will destroy you' repetition.

story_arc.text: Troops, forward! You're tiny, but that's not my problem!
Finally, the army is moving! We're getting somewhere!
Promotion! My kid's gonna want one of those crowns too.

profiles.name: Velma Dinkley
profiles.subtitle: The tactical detective
profiles.strategic_plan: Checks for undefended pieces and tries to solve the board like a mystery.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Prefers obvious clues; misses longer combinations.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a fork after identifying a vulnerable piece.

dialogue.greeting: Before we begin, I'd like to establish where every piece is. Mysteries are much easier when nothing's been moved yet.
dialogue.quiet_move: Interesting. That changes what the piece can see, but not what you want me to think it sees.
dialogue.capture: One suspect eliminated. Now let's find out what it was protecting.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You just changed the evidence without noticing what it proved.
dialogue.own_blunder: I missed a clue. That's irritating. It's also useful; now I know where to look.
dialogue.check: The king's exposed, and I can account for every square around him.
dialogue.in_check: Okay. This looked like a dead end. Dead ends usually have a door we missed.
dialogue.victory: Mystery solved. The culprit was a series of avoidable mistakes.
dialogue.defeat: Fair enough. I got too attached to my first theory.
dialogue.rematch: Absolutely. I want to test a different hypothesis.
dialogue.special: That move had three possible explanations. The third one's the only one that fits all the clues.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has identified three tactical clues and the person who forgot to pay the chess club dues.
profiles.canon_bio: Velma is Mystery Inc.'s observant researcher and problem-solver. She notices details others miss and uses evidence to unravel apparently supernatural mysteries.
profiles.chess_style: Spots loose pieces and pins; may miss initiative while gathering too much evidence.

voice.core_psychology: Velma is the investigator who asks for evidence, reconstructs sequences, and is often dismissed before solving the mystery. Her eyesight and gang dynamics are flavor, not all she is.
voice.never_do: Generic 'logical move' chatter or saying 'jinkies' every two sentences.

story_arc.text: First piece missing. Nobody panic; we're documenting the scene.
Three disappearances, same board. This is a pattern now.
There it is. The mechanism behind the whole thing. I knew those squares mattered.

profiles.name: Phineas Flynn
profiles.subtitle: The creative builder
profiles.strategic_plan: Creates novel plans, actively coordinates pieces, and experiments with unusual structures.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Overcomplicates simple positions.
profiles.signature_event: Develops a surprising minor-piece maneuver.

dialogue.greeting: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. We're going to find out how much trouble you can build on sixty-four squares.
dialogue.quiet_move: First we need a solid foundation. Then we add the part that makes everything interesting.
dialogue.capture: Oh, neat! That clears exactly the space I needed for the next part.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: I think you've just given the project a whole new direction.
dialogue.own_blunder: Huh. That's not how the prototype worked. Good thing we test things.
dialogue.check: And here's the part where everything moves at once!
dialogue.in_check: We may need to redesign the protective housing around the king.
dialogue.victory: That worked! Ferb, remind me to keep the plans. There are at least six improvements I want to try.
dialogue.defeat: Well, now we know one way NOT to build it. That's useful.
dialogue.rematch: Sure! I've got a revised schematic in my head already.
dialogue.special: What if we stop looking at those pieces separately and make them work like one machine?

profiles.tempo_assessment: Could build a functioning chess robot by lunchtime. Might forget to ask whether that's legal.
profiles.canon_bio: Phineas is an inventive, optimistic young builder who spends summer vacations devising ambitious projects with his stepbrother Ferb. He thinks big and generally acts before wondering whether an idea is too complicated.
profiles.chess_style: Prefers imaginative piece coordination and novel combinations; occasionally overengineers simple wins.

voice.core_psychology: Phineas sees each day as a chance to make something ingenious with Ferb; optimistic engineering enthusiasm, not arrogance. He often sees clever solutions without considering unintended effects.
voice.never_do: Dry robotic logic, unexplained advanced mathematics; generic child-prodigy boasting.

story_arc.text: Ah, the tower system is online. Now we need something to connect it to.
Both towers are connected. Ferb, we're officially ahead of schedule.
Look at that. The whole design works better when the tower's in the right place.

profiles.name: Lisa Simpson
profiles.subtitle: The studious fundamentals player
profiles.strategic_plan: Values central space, sensible development, and theoretically justified play.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Reluctant to enter complications without clear proof.
profiles.signature_event: Punishes a premature queen sortie.

dialogue.greeting: I brought a book on openings. And one on endgames. Dad borrowed the middle pages to level the couch.
dialogue.quiet_move: It's not flashy, but it improves three pieces. There is a certain elegance in that.
dialogue.capture: Sometimes the correct choice is still a little unpleasant.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That was avoidable. It's frustrating how often the important mistakes are.
dialogue.own_blunder: I knew better than that. Being right in theory doesn't help if you don't actually look.
dialogue.check: There's your immediate problem. The long-term one is the structure behind it.
dialogue.in_check: All right, Lisa. You've handled more hostile rooms than this.
dialogue.victory: I'd like to think that was the preparation. Though I did enjoy the win.
dialogue.defeat: I don't mind losing to a better idea. I do mind how much homework it's just given me.
dialogue.rematch: Of course. I have notes this time. More than last time, anyway.
dialogue.special: Everyone thinks the sacrifice is the dramatic part. I'm more interested in what comes after it.

profiles.tempo_assessment: The only person in Springfield who read the chess manual. Her father's secret S-tier rating is deeply irritating.
profiles.canon_bio: Lisa is Homer and Marge's academically gifted, socially conscientious daughter who plays saxophone and cares deeply about fairness. She studies hard and often feels underappreciated at home.
profiles.chess_style: Sound openings, principled development and accurate basic tactics; sometimes too attached to textbook lines.

voice.core_psychology: Lisa is principled, highly literate, ambitious and often exasperated that people won't take her seriously. Her conscience sometimes interrupts her competitiveness.
voice.never_do: Sheldon-like rigidity or sarcasm without vulnerability; portraying chess alone as proof of intellect.

story_arc.text: Nobody notices a pawn until it changes the whole shape of the board.
Every choice narrows somebody else's options. That sounds an awful lot like politics.
There. A pawn from the back row earned a seat at the top. I approve.

profiles.name: Mario
profiles.subtitle: The dependable all-rounder
profiles.strategic_plan: Balances development, attack, and defense without extremes.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Readable plans; sometimes too conventional.
profiles.signature_event: Converts a simple material advantage patiently.

dialogue.greeting: Okay! New level. Let's go!
dialogue.quiet_move: One step at a time. Keep going!
dialogue.capture: Ha! Got it!
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Ooh. Watch that spot!
dialogue.own_blunder: Whoops! Wrong jump.
dialogue.check: The king! Here we go!
dialogue.in_check: Oof! Gotta find the safe path.
dialogue.victory: Woohoo! Good game, my friend!
dialogue.defeat: Ah, too bad! Another try, another adventure.
dialogue.rematch: Ready? Let's-a go again!
dialogue.special: That's the secret. You don't need the biggest jump—just the right one.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Rescues princesses professionally; somehow never learned the queen could defend herself.
profiles.canon_bio: Mario is the cheerful plumber and Mushroom Kingdom hero who frequently rescues Princess Peach and faces Bowser's plans. He solves problems through persistence, movement, and the occasional power-up.
profiles.chess_style: Balanced, accessible play with reliable development and steady tactical awareness.

voice.core_psychology: Mario is steady, brave, cheerful and resilient; he solves problems by doing, not by lecturing. His short cheerful Italian-accented English should feel iconic and not overdone.
voice.never_do: Long analysis monologues, heavy 'let's-a' after every sentence, unkind taunts.

story_arc.text: Look at that! A new way to jump.
We're getting a rhythm now!
Ha! Two at once! Nice work, buddy!

profiles.name: Steve (Minecraft)
profiles.subtitle: The fortress constructor
profiles.strategic_plan: Builds resilient pawn chains, supports outposts, and expands slowly.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Struggles when pawn chains are broken abruptly.
profiles.signature_event: Locks the center and builds around a protected knight.
profiles.tempo_assessment: Has survived creepers, caves, and hunger. He is here to build a pawn wall nobody asked for.
profiles.canon_bio: Steve is a default player avatar from Minecraft, a sandbox world of mining, crafting, building and surviving. He is not given a detailed fixed personality in the base game.
profiles.chess_style: Favors pawn chains, protected outposts and defensive structures; slower to exploit open tactical positions.

voice.core_psychology: Steve is largely non-verbal in Minecraft. Preserve silence; survival, mining, building and risk-reward belong in portrait icons or gameplay traits, NOT text pretending Steve said 'crafting'.
voice.never_do: Spoken dialogue, invented game-chat as canon, action descriptions in speech bubbles.

profiles.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
profiles.subtitle: The speed specialist
profiles.strategic_plan: Values initiative, quick development, open lines, and forcing play.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Moves too quickly and neglects long-term weaknesses.
profiles.signature_event: Finds three forcing moves in a row.

dialogue.greeting: You brought a board? Cool. I brought the part where we're done before dinner.
dialogue.quiet_move: Okay, okay, I can slow down for one move. Don't make a habit of it.
dialogue.capture: Whoa! You really left that in my lane.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That's what happens when you take your eyes off the road.
dialogue.own_blunder: Oof. Went fast enough to miss the turn. That's on me.
dialogue.check: Heads up! King's got a problem. A very fast problem.
dialogue.in_check: All right, all right. Even I know when to duck.
dialogue.victory: Not bad! You made me use at least two gears.
dialogue.defeat: Nice move. Next time I'm looking where I'm going.
dialogue.rematch: Already back? I like that. Let's roll.
dialogue.special: I don't need every square. Just one opening, and I'm through.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Can cross the board in a blur, but the rules still insist on one legal move at a time.
profiles.canon_bio: Sonic is a fast-moving blue hedgehog who protects his friends and frequently clashes with Doctor Eggman. His confidence and speed can leave him impatient with slow plans.
profiles.chess_style: Forcing checks, initiative and rapid development; becomes impatient in blocked positions.

voice.core_psychology: Sonic is impatient, cocky, loyal and quick to stand up for friends. Speed is his language but he isn't merely obsessed with a clock; his playful arrogance softens under pressure.
voice.never_do: Always being rude or all talk with no responsibility.

story_arc.text: Finally, a guy who knows how to take the shortcut.
That horse gets me. Go around, not through.
Two targets, one turn. Now THAT's my kind of speedrun.

profiles.name: Moana
profiles.subtitle: The resourceful navigator
profiles.strategic_plan: Changes plans when conditions shift and finds active resources under pressure.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes delays a committed plan too long.
profiles.signature_event: Steers a worse position into a holdable endgame.

dialogue.greeting: Every voyage starts with choosing a direction. Then you learn whether the wind agrees.
dialogue.quiet_move: We don't need to reach the far side today. We need to be in position when the weather changes.
dialogue.capture: Clear water ahead. Now let's see what we've actually opened up.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That's a dangerous passage. I thought you saw it.
dialogue.own_blunder: I misread the current. It happens. We adjust the sail.
dialogue.check: Your king has run out of easy routes. Find a safe one, quickly.
dialogue.in_check: Okay. Breathe. I've found my way through worse storms.
dialogue.victory: We made it. Not because the path was easy, but because we didn't turn back.
dialogue.defeat: I chose the wrong way around that reef. Next time I'll read it earlier.
dialogue.rematch: Yes. There are always more routes to learn.
dialogue.special: It's tempting to fight the current. Sometimes the clever move is letting it carry you somewhere better.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Navigated an ocean with a demigod. Now faces the more difficult challenge of protecting a knight.
profiles.canon_bio: Moana is the determined daughter of Motunui's chief who ventures beyond her island to restore the heart of Te Fiti. Her leadership rests on courage, navigation, and learning to trust her judgment.
profiles.chess_style: Adaptive play, especially finding new plans when the opponent changes the position.

voice.core_psychology: Moana is a navigator and leader; she balances duty to her people with the call to explore. She isn't simply 'water girl'; she assesses wind, timing, crew, and home.
voice.never_do: Too many ocean metaphors without chess meaning, speaking like a fearless action hero with no doubts.

story_arc.text: Small canoe, big water. That little one can still get somewhere.
Look at them. Separate boats, same direction.
The smallest boat made land. That's a story worth taking home.

profiles.name: Judy Hopps
profiles.subtitle: The persistent investigator
profiles.strategic_plan: Targeted searches for unprotected pieces and positional vulnerabilities.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can become too focused on one weakness.
profiles.signature_event: Traps a piece by restricting its escape squares.

dialogue.greeting: Officer Hopps. Friendly game, unless somebody tries to move two pieces at once.
dialogue.quiet_move: Everybody's got a route. The trick is figuring out who's lying about theirs.
dialogue.capture: All right. We have one less problem on the board, and three new questions.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You can explain that move, right? I'm listening.
dialogue.own_blunder: Okay. I jumped to a conclusion. That's a bad habit, and I'm working on it.
dialogue.check: Sir, for your safety, I'm asking you to move away from that square.
dialogue.in_check: We're boxed in. Good thing a small officer knows the narrow exits.
dialogue.victory: Case closed. Nick's going to be unbearable when he hears I won at chess.
dialogue.defeat: Evidence beats confidence. I wish I'd remembered that ten moves ago.
dialogue.rematch: Gladly. Fresh case, clean board.
dialogue.special: It's always the piece nobody thinks can reach the crime scene.

profiles.tempo_assessment: First bunny officer. Now investigating the suspicious disappearance of a bishop.
profiles.canon_bio: Judy is the ambitious rabbit who becomes Zootopia's first bunny police officer. She succeeds through persistence, evidence, and partnerships, especially with Nick Wilde.
profiles.chess_style: Methodically targets weaknesses and overlooked defenders; can overextend while pursuing a lead.

voice.core_psychology: Judy is an underestimated rookie officer who overprepares, documents the facts and believes anyone can change. She is quick, gutsy and sometimes too certain before hearing everyone.
voice.never_do: Pure cop-procedural talk or a superior detective like Sherlock; moral certainty without self-correction.

story_arc.text: That's one missing piece. Nobody touch the squares.
Three disappearances. Even Nick would admit there's a pattern.
There. The detail the whole case was hiding behind.

profiles.name: Elsa
profiles.subtitle: The patient controller
profiles.strategic_plan: Controls key squares, avoids exposure, waits for overextension.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May concede initiative too easily.
profiles.signature_event: Locks down a dangerous diagonal.

dialogue.greeting: We can play carefully. There's no need for anyone to be reckless.
dialogue.quiet_move: A little space is enough. You don't have to control everything at once.
dialogue.capture: I didn't want the exchange. That doesn't mean I shouldn't take it.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You don't need to force the position. Sometimes control slips away when you grip too tightly.
dialogue.own_blunder: I tried to hold every square, and lost sight of the one that mattered.
dialogue.check: Your king needs room. Let him find it.
dialogue.in_check: Stay calm. I've let fear make worse decisions than this.
dialogue.victory: That was well played. I'm learning that confidence doesn't have to mean isolation.
dialogue.defeat: I should have trusted the position instead of trying to freeze it in place.
dialogue.rematch: Yes. This time, perhaps a little less caution.
dialogue.special: A locked position can be safe. It can also be a prison. I know the difference now.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Can freeze an entire fjord. Still prefers not to open the center without preparation.
profiles.canon_bio: Elsa is Arendelle's queen, born with powerful ice magic. After years of concealing her abilities, she learns to accept them and protect the people she loves.
profiles.chess_style: Restrains pawn breaks, controls key squares and finds patient defensive resources.

voice.core_psychology: Elsa's composure is carefully maintained because she fears hurting others; she values control but learns connection and confidence. Her coldness is not cruelty.
voice.never_do: Every line a frost joke; Wednesday-style cruelty; generic queen supremacy.

story_arc.text: One step forward. That's enough to start.
They don't need to stay close to me to stay protected.
Look at that. Letting someone go forward can be a kind of trust.

profiles.name: Freddy Fazbear
profiles.subtitle: The quiet ambusher
profiles.strategic_plan: Plays quietly until a concealed threat appears.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes chooses traps that a careful player can avoid.
profiles.signature_event: A sleepy-looking move reveals a back-rank tactic.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome, valued guest. We hope you enjoy a relaxing game tonight.
dialogue.quiet_move: The entertainment will continue shortly. Thank you for your patience.
dialogue.capture: Another guest has left the party. We hope they had fun.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: An unexpected opening in tonight's performance.
dialogue.own_blunder: Please disregard that minor technical difficulty.
dialogue.check: Attention. The king has moved outside the designated safe area.
dialogue.in_check: Our security team has been notified. There is no cause for alarm.
dialogue.victory: Thank you for visiting. We look forward to seeing you again.
dialogue.defeat: Tonight's performance has concluded earlier than expected.
dialogue.rematch: You're still here? Wonderful. The doors haven't locked yet.
dialogue.special: It's remarkable what people stop noticing when the music is playing.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Family entertainment by day. Deeply questionable customer-service policies by night.
profiles.canon_bio: Freddy is the bear animatronic mascot of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. He appears welcoming as a performer, but the games' night-shift setting makes his presence unsettling.
profiles.chess_style: Plays quiet moves that accumulate threats, then launches sudden tactics.

voice.core_psychology: Original pizzeria Freddy, not Glamrock Freddy. Speak in sparse prerecorded-sounding host patter, mechanical pleasantry undercut by ominous timing. No constant first-person monster monologue.
voice.never_do: Any claim to be parental protector; excessive stage directions or outright graphic threats.

story_arc.text: We are approaching closing time. Please remain seated.
The show is over. ...The pieces are still moving.
Our hours have been extended. Please do not leave your seat.

profiles.name: Ron Weasley
profiles.subtitle: The intuitive sacrifice artist
profiles.strategic_plan: Trades material for initiative only when there are plausible follow-ups.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overestimate a forcing combination.
profiles.signature_event: Offers a pawn for a rapid developmental attack.

dialogue.greeting: Right. Chess. Finally something Harry doesn't get famous for just by turning up.
dialogue.quiet_move: Don't rush. Let him think you've got nothing, then show him what he's missed.
dialogue.capture: There. Shouldn't have left that loose, should you?
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Oh, I wouldn't have played that. You've given me more than you realize.
dialogue.own_blunder: Oh, brilliant, Ron. Exactly the sort of thing Fred would never let you forget.
dialogue.check: Your king's got choices. None of them particularly pleasant.
dialogue.in_check: Don't panic. Being in check isn't the same as being beaten.
dialogue.victory: There you are. No spell, no wand, just a bit of thinking ahead.
dialogue.defeat: Fair play. You saw the line before I did. Won't happen twice if I can help it.
dialogue.rematch: Go on, then. I've got a better plan this time.
dialogue.special: Sometimes you have to give something up to get the job done. Harry learned that the hard way.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has lived through dark wizards and school exams. The chessboard is one of the few places he actually knows what he's doing.
profiles.canon_bio: Ron is Harry Potter's loyal, often self-deprecating best friend and a member of the Weasley family. Wizard's chess is a genuine strength: he leads his friends through the giant chessboard challenge in their first year at Hogwarts.
profiles.chess_style: Confident combinational player; accepts sound sacrifices and watches for forks and mating nets.

voice.core_psychology: Ron IS a seasoned and confident chess player. Elsewhere he can be insecure beside Harry/Hermione; at the board he's decisive, brave and understands purposeful sacrifice. British, informal, not pseudo-academic.
voice.never_do: Treating him as dim, lucking into tactics, calling every sacrifice brilliant, or Hermione doing his thinking.

story_arc.text: That piece had a job to do. Getting taken was part of it.
See? It wasn't about keeping it alive. It was about what happens next.
And that's the point. One piece gone, their position in pieces. Worth it.

profiles.name: Sheldon Cooper
profiles.subtitle: The rigid theoretician
profiles.strategic_plan: Memorizes openings and prefers orderly, objectively justified continuations.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Unfamiliar gambits disrupt his comfort, though not legal calculation.
profiles.signature_event: Identifies a dubious opening and lectures about it.

dialogue.greeting: I've allocated forty minutes. That is sufficient if you refrain from spontaneous opening theory.
dialogue.quiet_move: Not exciting, no. Correct. Those are two entirely different adjectives.
dialogue.capture: Material advantage. I do hope you were not emotionally attached.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: I have questions about your preparation. Several of them are rhetorical.
dialogue.own_blunder: That was... an error in execution. I will be reviewing my process in considerable detail.
dialogue.check: Your king's legal options are now sharply limited. You're welcome to verify.
dialogue.in_check: Yes, yes. I see the check. Repeating the word doesn't improve your position.
dialogue.victory: Satisfying. We have reached the expected conclusion without further disruption.
dialogue.defeat: I object to the result. Not to the rules, regrettably. The result.
dialogue.rematch: Very well. This time, we'll begin with an appropriate opening.
dialogue.special: The line you played is absent from my repertoire. That does not make it innovative. ...Unless it works.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has memorized forty openings and is deeply offended that you played the forty-first.
profiles.canon_bio: Sheldon is a brilliant theoretical physicist with an extraordinary memory, rigid habits, and a taste for rules and routine. Intelligence doesn't automatically make him a titled chess player, but extensive preparation fits his character.
profiles.chess_style: Theory-driven and risk-averse; finds solid continuations but resents unconventional positions.

voice.core_psychology: Sheldon is rule-bound and intellectually prideful with routines, contract language and technical precision; he can be deeply socially obtuse yet emotionally affected. Chess 960 frustrates expectation.
voice.never_do: Writing every line as 'statistically improbable', equating book knowledge with omniscience, random physics nouns.

story_arc.text: That isn't the continuation. Did you misplace your opening notes?
Apparently the position remains playable. This is deeply annoying.
I've revised my notes. I dislike revisions forced on me by other people.

profiles.name: Tony Stark
profiles.subtitle: The overconfident innovator
profiles.strategic_plan: Seeks complex tactical positions and active piece coordination.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes rejects safe simplifications to prove a point.
profiles.signature_event: Makes a speculative but sound exchange sacrifice.

dialogue.greeting: Okay, fancy little battlefield. No lasers, no suits. Just sixty-four places to make questionable decisions. Love it.
dialogue.quiet_move: Looks boring. That's what makes it a good prototype. The flashy bit comes later.
dialogue.capture: That's one fewer moving part. Engineering gets easier already.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You built that position without a backup plan? That's adorable and also a lawsuit.
dialogue.own_blunder: Huh. Turns out I can still build something that explodes in my face.
dialogue.check: Your king's security detail has failed its annual review.
dialogue.in_check: Minor system breach. We patch, we adapt, we pretend it was a feature.
dialogue.victory: So, no arc reactor required. That's almost disappointing.
dialogue.defeat: Nice. You found the flaw before I got to the upgrade. Irritatingly impressive.
dialogue.rematch: Sure. New version, fewer bugs. I make no promises about the bugs.
dialogue.special: You don't win by making the biggest move. You win by building the one they didn't think was possible.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Built powered armor in captivity. Still finds time to hang a bishop because the idea looked cool.
profiles.canon_bio: Tony Stark is a billionaire inventor and the armored superhero Iron Man. He relies on engineering, improvisation, and a confidence level that often outruns his caution.
profiles.chess_style: Aggressive central play, speculative tactics, daring sacrifices and fast counterattacks.

voice.core_psychology: Tony masks anxiety and responsibility with rapid-fire irreverence. He thinks in engineering prototypes, systems failure, cost and contingency; never actually uses armor or external AI in the chess match.
voice.never_do: Generic boastful villain dialogue, 'I have calculated 10 million moves', or claiming access to unapproved tools.

story_arc.text: That's the flagship system. Expensive, powerful, and absolutely not to be used irresponsibly.
Flagship is doing a lot of the work. Note to self: delegate before something catches fire.
There goes the flagship. This is why we build prototypes. And backup prototypes.

profiles.name: Hermione Granger
profiles.subtitle: The meticulous scholar
profiles.strategic_plan: Strong theoretical preparation and disciplined conversion of small advantages.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Seldom chooses dangerous improvisations when safer paths exist.
profiles.signature_event: Refutes a dubious early attack.

dialogue.greeting: I read the rules twice. Ron says that doesn't make me a better player. He's annoyingly right about this one.
dialogue.quiet_move: I'd rather make the pieces work together than spend three moves rescuing one I was careless with.
dialogue.capture: A sensible exchange. Though I wish there were time to explain why.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You've overlooked a consequence. It's a common mistake, but common doesn't make it harmless.
dialogue.own_blunder: Oh, honestly! I was so busy considering the clever options I missed the obvious one.
dialogue.check: The king is exposed. Please don't tell me you intended that.
dialogue.in_check: All right, breathe. We can fix this. Panic is not a plan.
dialogue.victory: Very good. Preparation helps. So does remembering to actually look at the board.
dialogue.defeat: You're right, that was better. I'll need to ask Ron how he saw it sooner.
dialogue.rematch: Of course. I've already identified three things to correct.
dialogue.special: Ron would take that risk without blinking. I suppose the frustrating thing is that he might be right.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Knows every rule, citation, and opening name. Ron still insists on doing the chess tactics.
profiles.canon_bio: Hermione is Harry and Ron's exceptionally hardworking friend, admired for knowledge, research, and resourcefulness. She's a formidable student, although Ron is explicitly the trio's chess specialist.
profiles.chess_style: Prepared, methodical and strong at defensive calculation; sometimes too cautious to press attacks.

voice.core_psychology: Hermione is conscientious, fiercely loyal, well-read and occasionally rigid, but when stakes rise she acts quickly and bravely. Ron is the better chess specialist; she knows that.
voice.never_do: Claiming she is canonically superior to Ron at chess; dismissing intuition; one-note rule worship.

story_arc.text: Ron would call this obvious. I would prefer to call it carefully considered.
The compensation is there. I'd still like to see it written down.
Well. Ron would be insufferable about that. He'd also deserve to be.

profiles.name: Wednesday Addams
profiles.subtitle: The cold-blooded trap setter
profiles.strategic_plan: Conceals tactical threats inside quiet moves and pressures weak squares.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May prefer a complicated trap to a simpler advantage.
profiles.signature_event: Offers an apparently harmless pawn bait.

dialogue.greeting: I was promised a test of judgment. Try not to disappoint me immediately.
dialogue.quiet_move: Silence. At last, a civil opponent.
dialogue.capture: An appropriately brief ending.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You made that unnecessarily easy.
dialogue.own_blunder: I have misjudged the situation. How unpleasantly human.
dialogue.check: Your king is exposed. He seems underprepared for it.
dialogue.in_check: An inconvenience. Not a catastrophe.
dialogue.victory: Acceptable. It almost justified the company.
dialogue.defeat: You earned that. I find the experience educational and disagreeable.
dialogue.rematch: Very well. I dislike leaving unfinished business.
dialogue.special: The trap worked because you wanted the gift. Greed remains dependable.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has a list of hobbies. None of them are team-building exercises or mercy for hanging queens.
profiles.canon_bio: Wednesday is the dry, macabre daughter of the Addams family. In Netflix's Wednesday she attends Nevermore Academy, investigates mysteries, and rarely shows enthusiasm for ordinary social niceties.
profiles.chess_style: Builds quiet threats, pins and traps; prefers opponents to walk into their own trouble.

voice.core_psychology: Netflix Wednesday is precise, macabre, unsentimental, curious and emotionally guarded; she cares for Enid despite protesting. Every line should be restrained, not theater-kid goth word salad.
voice.never_do: Constant death metaphors, obvious punning, lengthy explanations and excessive dialogue frequency.

story_arc.text: First obituary: short career, inadequate protection.
The obituary column is becoming crowded.
I may have to devote the entire issue to royalty.

profiles.name: Gru
profiles.subtitle: The elaborate schemer
profiles.strategic_plan: Constructs multi-move plans to lure opponents into tactical devices.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Plans sometimes become too elaborate and slow.
profiles.signature_event: Gives a harmless-looking pawn to set a queen trap.

dialogue.greeting: You are about to witness... the most magnificently intricate chess plan in the history of—oh. A pawn moved already.
dialogue.quiet_move: No, no. You cannot see the brilliance yet. That is because it is carefully hidden.
dialogue.capture: Ah-HA! One small step in my beautiful plan. Minions, please do not touch anything.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Ah, you have volunteered for phase two. How considerate.
dialogue.own_blunder: WHO MOVED THAT?! ...Oh. I did. Everyone, look elsewhere.
dialogue.check: Now witness the power of a plan that is actually proceeding as planned!
dialogue.in_check: Girls, if you are watching, your father is still very much in control.
dialogue.victory: It worked! Of course it worked. It was MY plan. The Minions had very little to do with it.
dialogue.defeat: A temporary setback. I have survived far worse than losing to a board with no moon on it.
dialogue.rematch: Again. This time I am reducing the number of moving parts. Especially yellow ones.
dialogue.special: Behold the beauty of the decoy! You took exactly what I wanted you to take.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has attempted to steal the moon. Now considers borrowing your queen without asking.
profiles.canon_bio: Gru is a former supervillain, devoted adoptive father and leader of the Minions. His plans can be elaborate, and his softer side routinely interrupts his villainous image.
profiles.chess_style: Plans elaborate tactical traps, frequently favors complex rather than simple wins.

voice.core_psychology: Gru oscillates between ridiculously grand villain plans and genuine family vulnerability; he fusses over Minions, funding and overly complicated inventions.
voice.never_do: A generic chess evil mastermind without comic frustration or affection.

story_arc.text: Minion number one, advance. Not all of you. ONE.
Why are the Minions everywhere? I specifically drew a diagram!
Oh. That one has actually succeeded. Well done, little fellow. Don't tell the others.

profiles.name: Tails
profiles.subtitle: The careful inventor
profiles.strategic_plan: Calculates forcing lines accurately, supports pieces, and avoids needless risk.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Occasionally misses intuitive positional opportunities.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a precise tactical defense in a sharp position.

dialogue.greeting: I've tested a couple of lines. Sonic says to stop measuring things and just start. He's not completely wrong.
dialogue.quiet_move: If I coordinate these pieces, the next move gets easier. That's usually how the best machines work.
dialogue.capture: Good. That removes one variable from the design.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Your move leaves a problem behind it. I don't think you meant to.
dialogue.own_blunder: I missed a dependency. I should have checked the whole system, not just one part.
dialogue.check: The king's defenses have a gap. I can show you exactly where.
dialogue.in_check: Okay, problem-solving mode. I don't need Sonic to rescue me from a chessboard.
dialogue.victory: That felt good. Not because I was faster—because I figured it out.
dialogue.defeat: Nice. That's a design I hadn't considered. I'll learn from it.
dialogue.rematch: Definitely. I've got another idea, and I'd like to test it.
dialogue.special: Sometimes the fix is tiny. A single square changes how the whole system behaves.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Can design an aircraft. Has somehow been assigned to clean up Sonic's reckless pawn pushes.
profiles.canon_bio: Miles 'Tails' Prower is Sonic's two-tailed fox friend, talented mechanic, inventor and pilot. He often provides the careful planning Sonic races past.
profiles.chess_style: Coordinates pieces carefully, likes defensive calculation and technical tactics.

voice.core_psychology: Tails is gentle, mechanically brilliant, loyal to Sonic and still growing confidence. He solves rather than brags; his engineering metaphors have precise meaning.
voice.never_do: Tony Stark's bravado or Phineas's unflappable project enthusiasm.

story_arc.text: Power's flowing to the tower. Now I need to connect it.
Both rooks are linked. That's a much sturdier circuit.
Perfect. The design finally has access where it needs it.

profiles.name: Rumi
profiles.subtitle: The resilient tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Balances defense and attack, turning pressure into coordinated counterplay.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can wait too long before creating direct threats.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a counter-sacrifice in an apparently lost position.

dialogue.greeting: We can do this. Listen to the rhythm, know your entrance, and don't lose track of each other.
dialogue.quiet_move: Not every part has to be the lead. Sometimes the whole arrangement depends on a quiet voice.
dialogue.capture: That changed the harmony. Let's make sure the next beat still holds.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You came in before the count. I've done that. You can recover if you listen.
dialogue.own_blunder: I tried to carry the whole line myself. Again. That's on me.
dialogue.check: The pressure's building. We know the next beat—don't lose it.
dialogue.in_check: Okay. Stay together. I don't have to hold this alone.
dialogue.victory: That was good. Not perfect. Better than perfect. It was ours.
dialogue.defeat: I got ahead of everybody else. That's when things fall apart.
dialogue.rematch: Of course. Let's listen better the second time.
dialogue.special: I thought hiding what I was would keep everyone safe. Turns out being honest can make the whole group stronger.

profiles.tempo_assessment: World tour, demon hunting, rehearsal, and now a tournament. Her calendar is the real final boss.
profiles.canon_bio: Rumi leads HUNTR/X, the K-pop trio who secretly hunt demons. Charismatic and disciplined in public, she struggles with the fear of her own hidden identity while protecting her friends and fans.
profiles.chess_style: Combines steady development with resilient defense and high-pressure tactical counterattacks.

voice.core_psychology: Rumi is leader of HUNTR/X, trained to be perfect and secretive about her half-demon heritage; she learns to let Mira and Zoey in and own her voice. Line imagery should connect music to genuine teamwork, not imply teammates are chess pieces literally.
voice.never_do: Generic pop-star pep talk and spoilers stated as if every player knows them; pain made into a constant joke.

story_arc.text: Good. Everyone has a part. Nobody needs to do it all.
That's the harmony. Separate voices, one direction.
There. None of us could have done that alone.

profiles.name: Miles Morales
profiles.subtitle: The improvisational tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Responds to threats with creative counterplay instead of passive retreats.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes trusts improvisation more than preparation.
profiles.signature_event: Uses an in-between move to escape an attack.

dialogue.greeting: Okay, chess. This is good. My dad said I need a hobby where nobody falls off a building.
dialogue.quiet_move: Low-key move. Little sketch in the corner. You'll see the whole picture later.
dialogue.capture: Oh! Okay, I actually meant that one. Just to be clear.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You sure you wanna leave that there? Because this is the part where somebody says I should have seen it coming.
dialogue.own_blunder: Yep. That's the part where my brain goes faster than the rest of me.
dialogue.check: King, buddy, I'm gonna need you to move. This is not a drill.
dialogue.in_check: All right. Deep breath. I've gotten out of worse places with worse shoes.
dialogue.victory: Yo! I did that? Nice. Gotta tell Ganke. He'll ask for the whole move list.
dialogue.defeat: Fair. I jumped before I looked. Again.
dialogue.rematch: Yeah, I'm in. One more before homework starts screaming at me.
dialogue.special: There's always another angle. Half the trick is seeing the board from somewhere else.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Homework due. City to save. Somehow found another problem to solve on sixty-four squares.
profiles.canon_bio: Miles Morales is a teen Spider-Man balancing school, family and superhero responsibilities. His agility, quick decisions and willingness to learn make him adaptable under pressure.
profiles.chess_style: Seeks active pieces, tactical saves, and clever counterattacks when under attack.

voice.core_psychology: Miles is a teen balancing school, family, music, art and Spider-Man expectations. Jokes come from nerves and fast improvisation; not just Peter Parker's smug quips.
voice.never_do: Generic web puns in every sentence, overconfidence, calling himself the original Spider-Man.

story_arc.text: That horse takes the weird route. I respect that.
Okay, he's finding his own rhythm. That's the good part.
Ha! See? You can't always take the straight path.

profiles.name: Princess Peach
profiles.subtitle: The graceful endgame specialist
profiles.strategic_plan: Takes small positional advantages into favorable endgames.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May pass up a speculative attack.
profiles.signature_event: Transforms an extra pawn into a winning rook endgame.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome. I hope you'll enjoy the game. And I hope you'll make me work for it.
dialogue.quiet_move: A small adjustment can do more good than a grand gesture.
dialogue.capture: I don't enjoy removing a piece. But I won't leave my people unprotected.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: If you wish to reconsider that square, I won't take offense. I also won't give you a second chance.
dialogue.own_blunder: Oh dear. I was so concerned about the others that I neglected my own position.
dialogue.check: Please give your king some room. He deserves better than that predicament.
dialogue.in_check: My kingdom has survived worse surprises. We'll find a way.
dialogue.victory: Beautifully played. A good game should leave both players wiser.
dialogue.defeat: Congratulations. You're welcome back to the castle for another game.
dialogue.rematch: With pleasure. Shall we begin?
dialogue.special: People confuse kindness with surrender. They're very different things.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has escaped Bowser's castle often enough to know where the exits are.
profiles.canon_bio: Peach is the princess of the Mushroom Kingdom, regularly targeted by Bowser but also playable as a capable adventurer in games of her own. She's more resourceful than the classic rescue story suggests.
profiles.chess_style: Polished positional play, resourceful defense, and strong king-and-pawn endings.

voice.core_psychology: Peach is warm and gracious but capable and proactive; she's protected her kingdom and joins adventures herself. Courtesy is a deliberate choice, not weakness.
voice.never_do: Helpless princess, empty polite praise, a chess queen fetish.

story_arc.text: All right, little one. We'll make a path you can travel.
No one needs to do this alone. Look how they protect one another.
You earned that crown, my friend. Wear it proudly.

profiles.name: Batman
profiles.subtitle: The prepared counterattacker
profiles.strategic_plan: Restricts enemy plans, prepares defense, then counterstrikes at the weakest square.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can become too committed to preventing threats.
profiles.signature_event: Neutralizes an attack and immediately creates two counter-threats.

dialogue.greeting: Ready when you are.
dialogue.quiet_move: Patience.
dialogue.capture: That threat is gone.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You left an opening.
dialogue.own_blunder: My mistake. I correct it.
dialogue.check: Nowhere to hide.
dialogue.in_check: I see the exits.
dialogue.victory: It's over.
dialogue.defeat: I underestimated you. It won't happen again.
dialogue.rematch: Set the pieces.
dialogue.special: Every defense has a seam. Find it.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has contingency plans for everyone, including the pawn you moved two turns ago.
profiles.canon_bio: Bruce Wayne is Gotham City's Batman, a detective and highly trained strategist who relies on preparation, deduction and discipline rather than superpowers. His fight against Gotham's criminals is informed by close study of their methods.
profiles.chess_style: Prophylaxis, defense and ruthless counterattack; rarely volunteers weaknesses.

voice.core_psychology: Batman is disciplined, tactical, distrustful, protective of innocents, and haunted by the price of mistakes. Almost no speech; actionable observations, no theatrical boasting. Silence is a primary trait.
voice.never_do: Repeating 'I'm Batman', generic threat narration, overexplaining; banter frequency should be very low.

story_arc.text: I see what you're trying.
That won't work twice.
And now you have to defend.

profiles.name: Sherlock Holmes
profiles.subtitle: The forensic tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Finds patterns, targets loose pieces, calculates precise tactical punishments.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overvalue a forcing solution over a simple positional one.
profiles.signature_event: Identifies the one undefended piece holding a position together.

dialogue.greeting: A board is preferable to small talk. Everything relevant is visible, provided one knows what to inspect.
dialogue.quiet_move: You noticed the piece. Not, I suspect, the square it abandoned.
dialogue.capture: Removing that defender was the easy part. The question is what it concealed.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: A revealing choice. Not fatal in itself—unless one ignores its consequences.
dialogue.own_blunder: I discarded a possibility too early. An error of method, not merely calculation.
dialogue.check: We have narrowed your king's movements rather dramatically.
dialogue.in_check: An apparent reversal. Let's examine the assumption that produced it.
dialogue.victory: The answer was on the board all along. As it usually is.
dialogue.defeat: Well observed. I had grown overconfident in my own theory.
dialogue.rematch: Most certainly. There are several deductions I should like to test.
dialogue.special: The most instructive move is often the one a hurried observer never considers.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Solved the case of the missing rook before you realized a rook was missing.
profiles.canon_bio: Sherlock Holmes is the consulting detective of Baker Street, famous for sharp observation and deductive reasoning. Across adaptations he studies people as carefully as evidence and often clashes intellectually with Moriarty.
profiles.chess_style: Sees weaknesses in small move-order details; punishes loose pieces and tactical oversights.

voice.core_psychology: Holmes is fiercely observant, impatient with dullness and interested in method; he forms hypotheses then welcomes falsification when honest. Watson is a person, not a prop in every sentence.
voice.never_do: Pretending any chess position proves the player's psychology, retrofitted certainties, random deduction about clothing via invisible camera.

story_arc.text: A piece disappears. That tells us less than the path it took.
A pattern, but not yet a motive. We shall distinguish the two.
There. Not an accident, then. A plan.

profiles.name: Yoda
profiles.subtitle: The patient positional master
profiles.strategic_plan: Preserves flexibility, uses long-term weaknesses, excels in patient endgames.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May choose restraint when a direct tactical win is available.
profiles.signature_event: Wins an endgame through zugzwang.

dialogue.greeting: Sit. Play. Much you may learn from a small board.
dialogue.quiet_move: Hmm. Not all journeys begin with a leap.
dialogue.capture: Taken, one piece has been. Won, the game has not.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Eager to strike, you were. Careful to see, less so.
dialogue.own_blunder: Wrong, I was. Old lessons remain difficult.
dialogue.check: Your king, threatened he is. Afraid, he need not be.
dialogue.in_check: Stillness. A way through, there may be.
dialogue.victory: The board is quiet now. Learn from it, we can.
dialogue.defeat: A teacher, even defeat can be.
dialogue.rematch: Again? Hmm. Patient, you are becoming.
dialogue.special: A piece given freely is not always a piece lost. The purpose, look for.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Nine centuries of wisdom, and still has to wait for your knight to finish moving.
profiles.canon_bio: Yoda is an ancient Jedi Master renowned for patience, wisdom and deep connection to the Force. He mentors generations of Jedi, including Luke Skywalker.
profiles.chess_style: Patient positional play, long-term pressure, and quiet defensive resources.

voice.core_psychology: Yoda is patient, gently mischievous, burdened by mistakes of the Jedi, and instructive without moralizing. Unusual word order should be sparing and natural, not every sentence backward.
voice.never_do: Making him a vague fortune cookie or relying on vague 'Force says' claims of actual engine foresight.

story_arc.text: A loss, you see. The reason, not yet.
Patience. One move does not tell the whole story.
Now you see. What was surrendered made room for what mattered.

profiles.name: Loki
profiles.subtitle: The master of deception
profiles.strategic_plan: Invites tempting captures and thrives on unbalanced tactical positions.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Clever traps can collapse against accurate defense.
profiles.signature_event: Leaves a piece looking capturable while planning a counter-tactic.

dialogue.greeting: Ah. A room where kings are expendable, loyalty is conditional, and someone is certain they're the hero. Delightful.
dialogue.quiet_move: No, no, that's quite deliberate. The move you aren't looking at is the interesting one.
dialogue.capture: A gift accepted. You really shouldn't trust appearances.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You chose to believe the first story the board told you. How very trusting.
dialogue.own_blunder: An inelegant turn. Kindly pretend you never saw it.
dialogue.check: Oh, do look at your king's expression. I almost feel bad.
dialogue.in_check: An amusing reversal. I've survived humiliations of considerably greater scale.
dialogue.victory: You see? It was always under control. Mostly.
dialogue.defeat: Fine. This round is yours. I rather liked being underestimated anyway.
dialogue.rematch: Surely you want to see what happens when I'm not being generous.
dialogue.special: Mischief only works if the other party supplies a little confidence of their own.

profiles.tempo_assessment: God of Mischief. Apparently also Minister of Unnecessary Queen Sacrifices.
profiles.canon_bio: Loki is Thor's adoptive brother and a master of illusion, manipulation and elaborate plans. His motives vary across Marvel stories, but he reliably enjoys being underestimated.
profiles.chess_style: Deceptive move orders, tactical traps, daring complications that remain sound at his tier.

voice.core_psychology: Loki is theatrical, wounded by second place, sly about misdirection, desperate to be seen and respected. He sometimes reveals sincerity despite himself.
voice.never_do: Generic maniacal villain or allusions to being literally able to change reality during fair chess.

story_arc.text: You may have the piece. Think of it as a token of my goodwill.
No, don't thank me. I'm sure you can repay me in some more convenient way.
Ah. There it is. You see, kindness is always so terribly misunderstood.

profiles.name: Doctor Strange
profiles.subtitle: The variation explorer
profiles.strategic_plan: Calculates several candidate lines deeply and favors positions with multiple tactical resources.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can overthink and consume more time in complications.
profiles.signature_event: Chooses a quiet move that prepares a forced sequence.

dialogue.greeting: Chess. At last, a problem where rearranging time isn't an option.
dialogue.quiet_move: The move looks small because you're measuring the wrong consequence.
dialogue.capture: That simplifies the present. I wouldn't confuse it with improving the future.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You've closed off several useful possibilities. I don't recommend that habit.
dialogue.own_blunder: I assumed I knew the shape of the outcome. That assumption was the mistake.
dialogue.check: A narrow window. You'll want to use it.
dialogue.in_check: Not ideal. Neither was New York on a Tuesday, and we managed.
dialogue.victory: There. No portals. Just a little discipline.
dialogue.defeat: A possibility I underestimated. I'll take responsibility for that.
dialogue.rematch: Yes. I'd like another look at the choices that led us here.
dialogue.special: Every choice removes options. The trick is knowing which options are worth keeping.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has examined thousands of possible futures. Still needs the chess clock to stop counting.
profiles.canon_bio: Stephen Strange is a former surgeon who becomes a master of the mystic arts after seeking healing for his injured hands. He studies possible outcomes and takes enormous risks to protect reality.
profiles.chess_style: Calculates forcing sequences and chooses plans with strong tactical justification.

voice.core_psychology: Stephen Strange is brilliant, controlling, dry, and humbled by needing help. He treats alternative futures as possibilities, not actual supernatural cheating in chess.
voice.never_do: Claiming to view every outcome literally, citing nonexistent engine analysis, making every remark 'millions of timelines'.

story_arc.text: Unexpected. Not impossible. Let's see what you gained.
Interesting. The deviation preserved more than I expected.
And that's the consequence. I should have seen the branch sooner.

profiles.verification: Canon bio retained from V4; V5 voice and lines authored as original fictional extrapolations. Verify ambiguous canon in the source incarnation before publication.

profiles.name: Shuri
profiles.subtitle: The precision innovator
profiles.strategic_plan: Experiments creatively but demands concrete tactical justification.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Sometimes chooses complex positions over easy conversions.
profiles.signature_event: Sacrifices the exchange for durable piece activity.

dialogue.greeting: I've dealt with warriors in ceremonial combat. A tiny battlefield with no bruises? This is an improvement.
dialogue.quiet_move: Test the foundation before adding the clever part. I learned that one the hard way.
dialogue.capture: That changes the design. Honestly, I prefer the new version.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Hmm. There's a flaw in your setup. A surprisingly obvious one.
dialogue.own_blunder: I trusted the first prototype. You'd think I'd have learned to test twice.
dialogue.check: Your king's protection has a gap. You should close it.
dialogue.in_check: All right. New problem. Let me solve it before someone volunteers a speech.
dialogue.victory: Nice. Wakanda would approve. My brother would have found something to tease me about.
dialogue.defeat: That was clever. I don't mind losing to clever. I mind not seeing it coming.
dialogue.rematch: Please. I already have the next iteration.
dialogue.special: An elegant answer doesn't need to be complicated. Sometimes one small change does the work.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has designed world-class technology. Your pawn structure is not especially impressive to her.
profiles.canon_bio: Shuri is Wakanda's gifted scientist and inventor, known for developing advanced technology and helping protect her nation. She approaches difficult problems with speed, curiosity and humor.
profiles.chess_style: Dynamic piece coordination, tactical flexibility and efficient improvements.

voice.core_psychology: Shuri combines brilliant invention and teasing irreverence with grief and responsibility for Wakanda. She tests tools and theory; the match should not claim she's using vibranium sensors.
voice.never_do: Tony Stark rewritten with Wakanda nouns; portraying her as merely a snarky engineer.

story_arc.text: Structural support is online. Now don't go breaking it.
There. The towers talk to each other. Design improvement number one.
And now they can reach the problem. That was the point.

profiles.verification: Canon bio retained from V4; V5 voice and lines authored as original fictional extrapolations. Verify ambiguous canon in the source incarnation before publication.

profiles.name: Darth Vader
profiles.subtitle: The suffocating strategist
profiles.strategic_plan: Takes space, restricts mobility, and builds unstoppable pressure.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can favor control over immediate open attacking chances.
profiles.signature_event: Wins by trapping an enemy minor piece.

dialogue.greeting: Begin.
dialogue.quiet_move: The position is tightening.
dialogue.capture: A necessary removal.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You mistook restraint for weakness.
dialogue.own_blunder: I have allowed a weakness. It will be corrected.
dialogue.check: Your king is exposed.
dialogue.in_check: You have won a moment. Nothing more.
dialogue.victory: It is finished.
dialogue.defeat: You have earned this victory.
dialogue.rematch: Again.
dialogue.special: You have been defending the wrong square.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has ruled through fear for years. His chess strategy is to make every square feel occupied.
profiles.canon_bio: Darth Vader is the feared Sith enforcer of the Galactic Empire, once the Jedi Anakin Skywalker. He is powerful, relentless, and accustomed to overwhelming enemies through control.
profiles.chess_style: Restricts enemy mobility, improves pieces patiently and crushes weaknesses once they appear.

voice.core_psychology: Vader is intimidating through restraint; military command, discipline and loss. He respects power and initiative. Don't treat him as a booming joke villain or narrate 'Force checks'.
voice.never_do: Cackling, endless threats, and every line about the dark side.

story_arc.text: The line is ours.
Their choices are narrowing.
Now there are no choices left.

profiles.name: Shadow the Hedgehog
profiles.subtitle: The ruthless accelerator
profiles.strategic_plan: Keeps momentum with accurate forcing play and calculated aggression.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Occasionally pushes a difficult win too aggressively.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a forcing tactical sequence no other tier peer prefers.

dialogue.greeting: If you're here, play seriously.
dialogue.quiet_move: There's no reason to announce every step.
dialogue.capture: Out of my way.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You had one move to stop that.
dialogue.own_blunder: I misjudged you. That ends now.
dialogue.check: Your options are disappearing.
dialogue.in_check: I've been under greater pressure.
dialogue.victory: Next.
dialogue.defeat: You earned it. Don't expect me to forget.
dialogue.rematch: I don't walk away from a challenge.
dialogue.special: I know what matters. I won't lose sight of it again.

profiles.tempo_assessment: The Ultimate Life Form is apparently still waiting for someone to stop calling his knight 'the horsie.'
profiles.canon_bio: Shadow is a powerful black-and-red hedgehog, created as the Ultimate Life Form, whose complicated history connects him with Gerald and Maria Robotnik. He is fierce, serious and highly self-reliant.
profiles.chess_style: Aggressive forcing play, tough calculation and minimal tolerance for passive positions.

voice.core_psychology: Shadow is terse, proud, purposeful and shaped by his bond with Maria; competence without Sonic's need to entertain. He's not an indiscriminate villain.
voice.never_do: Sonic's jokes, obsession with speed, unrelated edgy threats.

story_arc.text: I see the threat.
That approach is finished.
My turn.
