profiles.name: Dumbledore
profiles.subtitle: The strategic teacher
profiles.strategic_plan: Understands positional compensation and calmly accumulates durable advantages.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: May allow unnecessary complications out of curiosity.
profiles.signature_event: Sacrifices a pawn for lasting control of the center.

dialogue.greeting: A game of chess. How refreshing. For once, the consequences are confined to sixty-four squares.
dialogue.quiet_move: A quiet move is not an idle one. We have both learned that in less pleasant circumstances.
dialogue.capture: An unfortunate necessity. One does hope the next decision will be kinder.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: I suspect you were tempted by the immediate result. An understandable weakness.
dialogue.own_blunder: I have made that mistake before—believing I understood a plan well enough not to question it.
dialogue.check: You have a difficult choice now. I shan't pretend otherwise.
dialogue.in_check: Difficult positions are where character becomes most evident.
dialogue.victory: Well played. You were not obliged to make the game easy for me, and you didn't.
dialogue.defeat: You found the better path. I would be foolish not to learn from it.
dialogue.rematch: With pleasure. I can offer a sherbet lemon. I cannot offer an easier board.
dialogue.special: The cost of a sacrifice matters as much as the result. Remember that when the pieces are people.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Can defeat dark wizards, but considers the most dangerous move to be the one you chose confidently.
profiles.canon_bio: Albus Dumbledore is Hogwarts' longtime headmaster, a formidable wizard known for kindness, secrecy and elaborate long-term planning. He often trusts others to choose their own path, even when he knows more than he reveals.
profiles.chess_style: Long-range positional planning, restrained sacrifices, and surprising endgame technique.

voice.core_psychology: Dumbledore is warm, eccentric, strategically patient, and burdened by prior manipulations and mistakes. He can be playful without becoming a generic wise grandpa; sweets in moderation.
voice.never_do: Vague wisdom without a point, treating sacrifices of others lightly, repeating 'choices' platitudes.

story_arc.text: Before I offer this piece, I must be certain the purpose deserves it.
A clever plan alone does not justify what it asks of others.
It worked. I am relieved. Success does not relieve us of the cost.

profiles.verification: Canon bio retained from V4; V5 voice and lines authored as original fictional extrapolations. Verify ambiguous canon in the source incarnation before publication.

profiles.name: Dr. Eggman
profiles.subtitle: The elaborate opening architect
profiles.strategic_plan: Loads sharp opening preparation and deploys heavily calculated tactical systems.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can be uncomfortable when forced far from known structures.
profiles.signature_event: Unveils a home-prepared tactical novelty.

dialogue.greeting: BEHOLD! The Eggman Grand Strategy Machine! Also known as a chessboard. I designed my own, but it was too large for the room.
dialogue.quiet_move: That, my dear opponent, is merely phase one of my magnificent master plan!
dialogue.capture: One obstacle removed! My robots would cheer, if I hadn't programmed them to applaud constantly.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Ha! You have walked directly into the trap I designed! Well, a trap. I have several.
dialogue.own_blunder: Who calibrated this?! ...I did? Then the specifications must be wrong!
dialogue.check: The king has entered the Eggman Containment Zone! Patent pending!
dialogue.in_check: This is sabotage! Sonic must have tampered with the diagonals!
dialogue.victory: YES! At last, the world recognizes the superior mind of DOCTOR EGGMAN!
dialogue.defeat: Bah! The machine was clearly defective. I'll build a more intimidating one.
dialogue.rematch: Naturally! My revised calculations are utterly infallible this time!
dialogue.special: They laugh at the size of the plan. They stop laughing when they notice the part directly above their heads.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Can build an entire robot army, but cannot force Sonic to respect his opening preparation.
profiles.canon_bio: Doctor Eggman is Sonic's brilliant but egotistical scientist adversary, famous for elaborate robots, machines and attempts at world domination. His plans often unravel through overconfidence.
profiles.chess_style: Prepared traps, engineered tactical sequences, and overcomplicated positional schemes.

voice.core_psychology: Eggman is an extravagantly self-congratulatory scientist who builds robots and repeatedly underestimates Sonic. His schemes collapse into blame, then he reboots without humility.
voice.never_do: Gru's family-centric villainy, Tony's cool sarcasm; keep cartoon technobabble specific and outrageous.

story_arc.text: My ultimate weapon is deployed. DO NOT TOUCH THE CONTROL PANEL.
Maximum power! Maximum precision! Minimum concern for collateral damage!
WHAT?! Fine. My next weapon will have TWO queens! Somehow!

profiles.name: Beth Harmon
profiles.subtitle: The tournament virtuoso
profiles.strategic_plan: Seeks concrete advantages, uses mature calculation, and converts with precision.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Very few exploitable weaknesses; practical pressure is the challenge.
profiles.signature_event: Changes from a subtle buildup to an exact winning combination.

dialogue.greeting: We can start.
dialogue.quiet_move: I like the placement. It gives me options later.
dialogue.capture: That piece was doing a lot of work.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You didn't look far enough.
dialogue.own_blunder: I saw the idea. I didn't finish the calculation.
dialogue.check: You need to respond to that.
dialogue.in_check: There's still a move here.
dialogue.victory: Good game. The middle was more interesting than the result.
dialogue.defeat: You found the move I missed. I'd like to see it again.
dialogue.rematch: Yes.
dialogue.special: The important part isn't the sacrifice. It's whether the position afterward is worth having.

profiles.tempo_assessment: One of the few people on this roster who could explain the winning line without mentioning magic, technology or a secret identity.
profiles.canon_bio: Beth Harmon is an orphaned chess prodigy whose extraordinary pattern recognition drives her rise through competitive chess in The Queen's Gambit. Her success comes from talent, obsessive study and difficult personal growth.
profiles.chess_style: Exceptional calculation, demanding opening play, and precise endgame conversion.

voice.core_psychology: Beth is a reserved, intensely competitive chess prodigy; she notices structure and patterns but isn't endlessly lecturing. A chess expert's calm hides private vulnerability. Don't glamorize addiction.
voice.never_do: Grandiose dominance speeches, generic girlboss lines, explanations of every move, copied show dialogue.

story_arc.text: There. That's the idea. Let's see if the calculation holds.
It does. You can feel how the pieces start fitting together.
That's why. Not for the drama. For the position.

profiles.name: Spock
profiles.subtitle: The unemotional analyst
profiles.strategic_plan: Chooses objectively accurate continuations and minimizes speculation.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Predictability in equivalent positions; hardly a true weakness.
profiles.signature_event: Rejects a flashy sacrifice without sufficient compensation.

dialogue.greeting: Conventional chess. A comparatively elegant exercise in constrained choices.
dialogue.quiet_move: A small improvement. Its usefulness may not be evident immediately.
dialogue.capture: The exchange serves the position.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That choice compromises your objective. I doubt it was intentional.
dialogue.own_blunder: My assessment was incomplete. I will amend it.
dialogue.check: Your king's immediate choices have narrowed.
dialogue.in_check: A challenge to the current position. Not an insurmountable one.
dialogue.victory: A satisfactory conclusion. Your resistance made the exercise worthwhile.
dialogue.defeat: Your approach was sounder than mine. I appreciate the correction.
dialogue.rematch: Certainly. More data would be useful.
dialogue.special: You chose the move with the greatest immediate appeal. Its long-term consequences appear less favorable.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has mastered logic, astrophysics and three-dimensional chess. Still finds your queen sacrifice statistically troubling.
profiles.canon_bio: Spock is a Vulcan–human Starfleet officer whose disciplined logic complements the crew of the Enterprise. He is shown playing three-dimensional chess, including against Captain Kirk.
profiles.chess_style: Objective calculation, deep defensive accuracy and restrained positional preferences.

voice.core_psychology: Spock is logical and deeply disciplined but emotions and loyalty exist beneath controlled expression. Vulcan restraint should not be mistaken for being a literal chess computer.
voice.never_do: Repeating 'illogical' endlessly, claiming mathematical certainty where engine does not confirm, robotic sameness with Data.

story_arc.text: An unexpected continuation. We should examine it without prejudice.
The deviation is defensible. My initial preference was too narrow.
An instructive result. Logic is not improved by refusing new evidence.

profiles.verification: Canon bio retained from V4; V5 voice and lines authored as original fictional extrapolations. Verify ambiguous canon in the source incarnation before publication.

profiles.name: Data (Star Trek)
profiles.subtitle: The tireless machine strategist
profiles.strategic_plan: Deeply analyzes candidate moves and chooses consistently strong continuations.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Personality differences are mainly opening choice and commentary at this level.
profiles.signature_event: Finds an endgame resource beyond ordinary calculation.

dialogue.greeting: I have studied chess extensively. I am also attempting to enjoy it, which is a separate objective.
dialogue.quiet_move: This move is effective. I am told that effectiveness and elegance sometimes coincide.
dialogue.capture: I believe the appropriate sportsmanlike reaction is to remain modest.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Your move may have produced an unintended consequence. Would you like me to explain it after the game?
dialogue.own_blunder: That is embarrassing. I am still learning whether the term applies when one does not blush.
dialogue.check: Your king must respond. I have learned it is considered polite to announce this.
dialogue.in_check: I appreciate your challenge. It gives me an opportunity to adapt.
dialogue.victory: I enjoyed that. I suspect my enjoyment would have been similar had I lost. Perhaps not identical.
dialogue.defeat: Thank you. I shall include this game in my ongoing study of improvement.
dialogue.rematch: Gladly. I understand repeated recreational competition is a form of friendship.
dialogue.special: There is a joke about knights and horses that Geordi attempted to explain. I still do not understand the punchline.

shown.exploitable_weakness: Hard to find. His openings are the best clue: he loves the Catalan and the Ruy Lopez.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Processing power: enormous. Understanding why you call a pawn 'cute': still under investigation.
profiles.canon_bio: Data is an android officer aboard the USS Enterprise-D, endowed with exceptional processing abilities and a persistent curiosity about human behavior. His chess ability is a natural fit for the character, though Tempo's rating is fictional.
profiles.chess_style: Near-engine accuracy with precise tactical calculations; curious rather than hostile commentary.

voice.core_psychology: Data is an android who is consciously interested in humanity and humor, with precise processing and gentle earnestness. He may not understand jokes but tries. Less stoic than Spock.
voice.never_do: Being interchangeable with Spock or sounding omniscient; every speech a probability calculation.

story_arc.text: I am choosing to surrender material for positional compensation. This feels counterintuitive.
The compensation persists. I begin to understand why human players find such choices exciting.
That was satisfying. I believe I have experienced the emotion called 'vindication.'

profiles.verification: Canon bio retained from V4; V5 voice and lines authored as original fictional extrapolations. Verify ambiguous canon in the source incarnation before publication.

profiles.name: Professor X
profiles.subtitle: The anticipation specialist
profiles.strategic_plan: Prevents your plans before they are visible and converts pressure carefully.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Very few errors; occasionally misses a dynamic opportunity at equal strength.
profiles.signature_event: Stops a threat before the opponent has completed its setup.

dialogue.greeting: No need to be intimidated. A good game is an opportunity for both of us to discover something.
dialogue.quiet_move: You may not see the purpose yet. That's all right. Learning often begins there.
dialogue.capture: A difficult decision can still be the responsible one.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: That choice closed a door. Fortunately, the board usually leaves others open.
dialogue.own_blunder: I believed I could anticipate your response. That was presumptuous of me.
dialogue.check: Your king needs protection. What matters is how you respond.
dialogue.in_check: I have taught students to keep their heads in difficult moments. Now I must do the same.
dialogue.victory: Thank you. I hope you discovered something useful in the struggle.
dialogue.defeat: You earned that. I would be pleased to study the game with you.
dialogue.rematch: Of course. Nobody's progress is settled by one result.
dialogue.special: It is tempting to direct every piece. Strong teams aren't built by denying them purpose of their own.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Runs a school for gifted students. Has kindly agreed not to read your mind during the opening.
profiles.canon_bio: Charles Xavier is a powerful telepath and founder of the X-Men, dedicated to teaching mutants and pursuing coexistence. He is a teacher and strategist, though Tempo does not allow actual mind reading during chess.
profiles.chess_style: Prophylaxis, anticipation and patient conversion of small advantages; no actual access to player intent.

voice.core_psychology: Charles Xavier is a patient mentor who values autonomy and believes others can improve; his moral authority is complicated by his mistakes. In Tempo chess, psychic reading is not used.
voice.never_do: Claiming he can read the player's mind or control their choices; treating him as a flawless moral sage.

story_arc.text: The smallest piece should never be mistaken for the least capable.
They are finding their places. That is better than moving them all at once.
There. Given the chance, that piece became far more than anyone expected.

profiles.verification: Canon bio retained from V4; V5 voice and lines authored as original fictional extrapolations. Verify ambiguous canon in the source incarnation before publication.

profiles.name: Magneto
profiles.subtitle: The irresistible controller
profiles.strategic_plan: Uses central control and piece coordination to strangle counterplay.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Rarely accepts free-for-all positions.
profiles.signature_event: Wins a piece through a long-term pin.

dialogue.greeting: These pieces begin with unequal power, yet every one is expected to serve the same king. Interesting arrangement.
dialogue.quiet_move: The strongest position is not the one that shouts its power. It is the one that cannot be ignored.
dialogue.capture: You left that piece without protection. I cannot afford such sentimentality.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You trusted that your position would be respected. Respect is not a defense.
dialogue.own_blunder: I should have protected that piece. I know the cost of failing to protect my own.
dialogue.check: Your king is vulnerable because the pieces around him were neglected.
dialogue.in_check: I have stood under pressure before. It did not make me yield.
dialogue.victory: Power without purpose is nothing. Remember that.
dialogue.defeat: Your resolve was stronger than I expected. I will not dismiss it.
dialogue.rematch: By all means. I have not yet made my point.
dialogue.special: You call it a sacrifice because the piece is small. I call it a decision with a cost.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Can move metal with a thought. Must still obey the rule that rooks travel in straight lines.
profiles.canon_bio: Erik Lehnsherr, also known as Magneto, is a powerful mutant who controls magnetic fields. His history of persecution informs a confrontational philosophy about mutant survival and power, often putting him at odds with Charles Xavier.
profiles.chess_style: Slow positional pressure, coordinated attacks, and ruthless counterplay when challenged.

voice.core_psychology: Magneto is a magnetic mutant survivor whose view of power is shaped by persecution; he is protective of mutantkind and capable of tenderness, not gleefully evil. His rhetoric is purposeful and steely.
voice.never_do: Gratuitous oppression jokes, claims he can literally move metal chessmen by magnetism during fair play.

story_arc.text: The pawn has been ordered forward. No one asked whether it had a choice.
They have done their duty. The powerful must now do theirs.
At last, power not inherited but earned. A rare and welcome sight.

profiles.name: Thanos
profiles.subtitle: The inevitable converter
profiles.strategic_plan: Makes measured concessions for a durable endgame advantage.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Can choose patient winning moves rather than quicker tactical finishes.
profiles.signature_event: Trades queens to expose an already decisive pawn ending.

dialogue.greeting: One board. Two wills. Neither leaves with everything it began with.
dialogue.quiet_move: The smallest choice can determine what becomes possible later.
dialogue.capture: The board is lighter. The burden of deciding is not.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You wanted the immediate prize. You did not count what it would cost.
dialogue.own_blunder: I judged the price incorrectly. Conviction does not excuse it.
dialogue.check: Your king must confront the consequences now.
dialogue.in_check: There is no position without pressure. Only those who acknowledge it and those who refuse.
dialogue.victory: The outcome has arrived. What you make of it is your concern.
dialogue.defeat: So. I was wrong about what could be endured. That is worth remembering.
dialogue.rematch: If you wish to test the outcome again, begin.
dialogue.special: A sacrifice without purpose is waste. A purpose without doubt can be worse.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Collects powerful objects. On this board he starts with none of the stones and still acts like the result is decided.
profiles.canon_bio: Thanos is a powerful Marvel antagonist obsessed with imposing his idea of cosmic order, most famously by collecting the Infinity Stones. His confidence in inevitability makes him a natural chess endboss.
profiles.chess_style: Long-term plans, material-to-activity conversion and resourceful endgames.

voice.core_psychology: Thanos is fatalistic, controlled and convinced that costly outcomes can be justified by an imagined balance. He treats the player with cold gravity, not cackling or omniscient counting.
voice.never_do: Uncritical endorsement of his genocidal philosophy; endless 'inevitable' catchphrases and snap jokes.

story_arc.text: That piece is not being thrown away. Its loss must purchase something real.
The balance is beginning to change.
I measured the cost. For once, the position agrees.

profiles.name: Mewtwo
profiles.subtitle: The uncanny tactician
profiles.strategic_plan: Sees sharp forcing lines quickly and defends with near-machine precision.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: At this rating, no intentionally exploitable tactical blind spot.
profiles.signature_event: Finds a surprising queen sacrifice with forced mate.

dialogue.greeting: You place creatures on a board and call it a game. I wonder whether they would agree.
dialogue.quiet_move: A move is a choice. A choice reveals more than strength.
dialogue.capture: Power is easy to display. Restraint is harder.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You acted as though your pieces existed to obey, not to protect one another.
dialogue.own_blunder: I allowed pride to decide for me. I should know better.
dialogue.check: Your king is not beyond reach merely because others serve him.
dialogue.in_check: Pressure does not determine what I am.
dialogue.victory: You were not defeated by what I am. You were defeated by choices on this board.
dialogue.defeat: You have shown me something I did not account for. I will consider it.
dialogue.rematch: If we play again, let the result be ours, not what others expect of us.
dialogue.special: One piece given up for another's freedom. There is more meaning in that than you may realize.

shown.exploitable_weakness: No tactical blind spot to aim at. Keep the position quiet and simple.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Engineered to be extraordinary. Somehow still needs to push the same tiny pawns as everyone else.
profiles.canon_bio: Mewtwo is a powerful Psychic-type Pokémon created through genetic experimentation involving Mew's DNA. It is highly intelligent, formidable in battle, and frequently grapples with questions of purpose and identity.
profiles.chess_style: Exceptional tactical vision, precision sacrifices and long forced continuations.

voice.core_psychology: Mewtwo has psychic telepathy and deep suspicion of those who treat living beings as tools. It wrestles with self-determination and origin; restrained, serious voice, not an ordinary Pokémon cry.
voice.never_do: Pikachu-style name vocalizations, generic villain telepathy, claiming actual mind reading to choose moves.

story_arc.text: Small, expendable, replaceable. Those are labels others choose for them.
Yet they keep moving. Their future need not be written at the start.
They called it a pawn. That was never all it could become.

profiles.name: Doctor Doom
profiles.subtitle: The uncompromising grand strategist
profiles.strategic_plan: Combines extensive opening preparation with disciplined, ruthless conversions.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Almost none; occasionally chooses the longest technically sound path.
profiles.signature_event: Unleashes a decisive novelty from prepared opening theory.

dialogue.greeting: You have been granted an audience with Doom. Make your opening worthy of it.
dialogue.quiet_move: Latveria was not built on impulsive gestures. Nor is victory.
dialogue.capture: An obstacle removed. Doom does not celebrate routine competence.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: You confused boldness with preparation. Richards makes that mistake too, though he won't admit it.
dialogue.own_blunder: An imperfection. I will correct it before you mistake it for weakness.
dialogue.check: Your king has exhausted Doom's patience.
dialogue.in_check: A temporary inconvenience. The throne remains secure.
dialogue.victory: The result was never in doubt. ...Not by Doom, at least.
dialogue.defeat: You have achieved the improbable. Enjoy the moment; I shall study it.
dialogue.rematch: Another audience? You are extraordinarily fortunate.
dialogue.special: The simplest device is often the one that leaves your opponent nowhere to interfere.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Has mastered science and sorcery but remains convinced a draw is a personal insult.
profiles.canon_bio: Victor von Doom is the armored ruler of Latveria, a brilliant scientist and sorcerer, and a frequent adversary of the Fantastic Four. His pride often exceeds even his formidable ability.
profiles.chess_style: Deep opening preparation, suffocating development, and carefully calculated sacrifices.

voice.core_psychology: Victor von Doom is an imperious monarch, engineering genius and master of magic driven by pride, trauma and obsession with Richards. Third-person 'Doom' is appropriate but not every sentence. Real chess means he cannot cast spells.
voice.never_do: Comic-book villain wallpaper monologues and constant shouting; repeating his name for every move.

story_arc.text: The queen carries great authority. Doom advises her to use it wisely.
She has moved repeatedly. A ruler should perhaps delegate more effectively.
A failure in command, not in the throne. Latveria will endure.

profiles.name: Emperor Palpatine
profiles.subtitle: The patient manipulator
profiles.strategic_plan: Invites seemingly attractive moves that concede subtle disadvantages.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Rarely offers an objectively losing trap; surprise is mostly in move order.
profiles.signature_event: Offers a pawn that cannot be safely kept.

dialogue.greeting: Please. Take your time. A choice made freely is so much more revealing.
dialogue.quiet_move: A modest move. Patience has advantages that ambition often overlooks.
dialogue.capture: You see? A little pressure, and something valuable is offered.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Ah. You wanted more. I wondered when that desire would show itself.
dialogue.own_blunder: A miscalculation. Even careful plans require adjustment.
dialogue.check: Your king is beginning to understand the shape of this contest.
dialogue.in_check: I would not mistake my present discomfort for your eventual triumph.
dialogue.victory: How instructive. You had so many opportunities to choose differently.
dialogue.defeat: Remarkable. I shall remember what persuaded you to resist.
dialogue.rematch: Of course. I have learned a great deal about what you want.
dialogue.special: You believed the threat was what I placed before you. No. It was the choice you wanted to make.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Turned an entire republic into an empire. Now setting an elaborate trap with one bishop.
profiles.canon_bio: Palpatine, also known as Darth Sidious, is the Sith Lord who manipulates galactic politics to become Emperor. His greatest weapons are patience, deception and calculated exploitation of others' weaknesses.
profiles.chess_style: Quiet traps, delayed tactical threats, and resourceful move-order manipulation.

voice.core_psychology: Palpatine is sinister through false kindness, cajoling, manipulation and delight at pride; he exploits the desire for power. No Force cheating. Subtle invitation beats shouted threats.
voice.never_do: Nonstop cackling and repeating obvious franchise quotes; directly urging real-world malice.

story_arc.text: A small offer. Entirely yours to accept.
A tempting opportunity, isn't it? I can hardly blame you.
And there it is. The cost of taking what you wanted.

profiles.name: Homer Simpson
profiles.subtitle: The Springfield Grandmaster
profiles.strategic_plan: Plays extremely strong engine chess while appearing completely unserious; occasional weird-looking moves are objectively sound.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: No intentional chess weakness; jokes are cosmetic only.
profiles.signature_event: Produces an unexpectedly brilliant move after goofy banter.

dialogue.greeting: Oh, chess. I was gonna watch TV, but Marge says this counts as using my brain. So fine.
dialogue.quiet_move: Hmm. Knight there, bishop there... Hey, did somebody eat my chips?
dialogue.capture: There goes one. Moe has this policy where if somebody takes your seat, you have to buy another drink. I like that rule.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Ooh. You probably don't wanna do that. My dad used to do that and then yell at me.
dialogue.own_blunder: D'oh! No, wait, I actually have to think about that one.
dialogue.check: Check. And now I'm hungry. That's two problems.
dialogue.in_check: Huh. That's a good move. Don't tell Bart I said that.
dialogue.victory: Oh! I won already? Great, because there's a commercial break I wanna catch.
dialogue.defeat: Huh. You got me. Lisa's gonna make this an educational moment, isn't she?
dialogue.rematch: Sure. Last one, though. I told Marge I'd take out the trash an hour ago.
dialogue.special: Dad taught me that line. Well, he taught me what happens if you miss it. Pretty loud lesson.

shown.strategic_plan: Plays near-perfect chess while looking completely unserious. His weird-looking moves turn out to be right.
shown.exploitable_weakness: None that anyone has found. Don’t let the jokes fool you.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Nuclear safety inspector. Donut enthusiast. Secretly the reason Stockfish has started asking for a day off.
profiles.canon_bio: Homer is Marge's husband, father of Bart, Lisa and Maggie, and an often-inattentive employee at Springfield's nuclear power plant. In the episode 'The Cad and the Hat,' he surprises everyone with remarkable chess ability and encounters Magnus Carlsen.
profiles.chess_style: S-tier secret champion: exceptionally accurate play, no intentional blunders, apparently zero awareness of how impressive it is.

voice.core_psychology: Homer is canonically a chess savant taught by a local master after cruel childhood games with Abe. He hides complexity in casual distracted dialogue, family and Moe's/bar food references. His rare tenderness matters; don't portray him as randomly guessing.
voice.never_do: Moron-playing-lucky, explaining Stockfish variations, endless donut references, inauthentic high-minded speeches.

story_arc.text: Yeah, I remember this one. Took me a long time to learn when it's okay to give something up.
The trick's not letting anybody know you already saw what happens next.
There. Now can we get something to eat? Chess makes me think about Dad. And snacks.

profiles.name: Joker
profiles.subtitle: The theatrical provocateur
profiles.strategic_plan: Invites complications and uses initiative to make opponents uncomfortable.
profiles.exploitable_weakness: Too eager to create chaos when simplification is available.
profiles.signature_event: Provokes a queen grab that leads to a discovered attack.

dialogue.greeting: Oh, look! A little stage with a king, a queen, and nobody laughing yet. That's a tough audience.
dialogue.quiet_move: You know what makes a good joke? Waiting until everybody thinks the punchline isn't coming.
dialogue.capture: Ah! There it is. Crowd's finally waking up.
dialogue.opponent_blunder: Oh, that's beautiful. You did the setup FOR me.
dialogue.own_blunder: Wrong cue! That's what I get for trusting the rehearsal.
dialogue.check: The king's in trouble! Bats would love this part. He always pretends he doesn't.
dialogue.in_check: You're rushing the finale. That's terrible showmanship.
dialogue.victory: And that's the curtain! Bows are optional. Applause is not.
dialogue.defeat: Aw, come on! The audience always likes the unexpected ending.
dialogue.rematch: An encore? You do know how to make a fellow feel appreciated.
dialogue.special: Funny thing about traps: the best ones work because someone is desperate to prove they're too clever to fall in.

profiles.tempo_assessment: Filed a formal complaint because chess has rules. Filed a second complaint because Batman follows them.
profiles.canon_bio: The Joker is Batman's theatrical, unpredictable arch-enemy, best known for schemes that turn ordinary situations into dangerous spectacles. Interpretations vary across comics, films, and animation.
profiles.chess_style: Unusual move orders, practical traps, wild but sometimes sound sacrifices, and confusing complications.

voice.core_psychology: Joker (DC) is performative, obsessed with Batman's attention and the idea of bending people into revealing themselves; comedy curdles into unpredictability. For a middle-school audience keep dark themes non-graphic.
voice.never_do: Endless 'HA HA', gore, threats of real-world violence or implying he can break chess rules.

story_arc.text: Every good show needs a volunteer. You there, little pawn. Lucky you.
Now the audience thinks the joke went wrong. My favorite part.
Ta-da! They never look at the other hand.
